h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Cuttack

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Cuttack

c: Cuttack is the old capital of Odisha, built on the land between the Mahanadi and the Kathajodi rivers and protected by long embankments. It is famous for its silver filigree work and for Barabati Stadium. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Cuttack to schools, colleges, municipal parks, sports clubs, hospitals and housing societies. The machines are made at our Vasai factory, about 1,360 km away, and delivered by road.

A city between two rivers has wet soil and a high water table, especially during and after the monsoon. Every machine needs a firm footing, and the gym area needs to drain. We grout most machines into concrete and suggest raising the base slightly. Cuttack's old city is closely built, so many open gyms here go into small parks or club grounds. On these sites, combination machines and double stations give more exercise from each footing.

richText.heading: More from each footing in a small park

covers the legs for two users. A single
is a familiar first machine for older residents. Lay a paved or rubber surface under the gym, as grass in a busy small park soon turns to mud in the rains.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,360 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How do you fix machines on wet riverside soil?
items.a: We grout each post into a concrete footing and suggest a slightly raised, sloped base. This keeps the machines firm and the area dry enough to use after rain.

items.q: Can a sports club in Cuttack order an open gym?
items.a: Yes. Send us the size of the space and the number of members likely to use it at once. We will suggest strength and cardio machines and draw a layout.

items.q: What warranty do the machines carry?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. Both cover manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as we advise.
